avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Stimulates IL-6 production and may counteract tocilizumab's immunosuppressive effects; increases infection risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on immunosuppression risk

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, reducing tocilizumab metabolism and increasing hepatic clearance of concomitant medications
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue at least 2 weeks before tocilizumab initiation; avoid during treatment

caution_supplements.name: Astragalus
caution_supplements.mechanism: Immunostimulant properties may partially counteract tocilizumab's mechanism; generally weak interaction
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for reduced efficacy; counsel on immunosuppression awareness

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May modulate immune response; generally considered safe but monitor clinical response
caution_supplements.action: Use high-quality formulations; monitor therapeutic efficacy

avoid_foods.name: High-dose vitamin A supplements (from food sources)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Excessive vitamin A can impair immune tolerance and increase infection risk in immunosuppressed patients
avoid_foods.action: Maintain normal dietary intake; avoid supplementation beyond RDA (700-900 mcg)

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may affect metabolism of drugs used concurrently with tocilizumab; minimal direct effect on tocilizumab
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; monitor for drug interactions with concomitant medications

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (excessive)
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase hepatotoxicity risk and impair immune function in immunosuppressed patients
caution_foods.action: Counsel on moderate consumption; monitor liver function tests

monitoring_notes: Tocilizumab significantly affects CYP enzyme activity and may reduce metabolism of numerous medications; baseline and periodic monitoring of hepatic function, lipid panel, and neutrophil count is essential. Monitor for signs of infection given IL-6 antagonism suppresses infection-related inflammatory response.
